# relay_regions (Data Source)

Lists the cloud regions the platform serves, with the database engines and whether private endpoints are available in each. Every filter is optional.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_regions" "private_postgresql" {
  cloud             = "aws"
  engine            = "postgresql"
  private_endpoints = true
}

resource "relay_private_endpoint_service" "this" {
  for_each = { for r in data.relay_regions.private_postgresql.regions : r.region => r }

  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cloud        = each.value.cloud
  region       = each.value.region
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Only regions of this cloud, for example `aws`.
- `engine` (String) Only regions that serve this database engine, for example `postgresql`. Case-insensitive.
- `private_endpoints` (Boolean) `true` keeps only regions with private endpoints, `false` only regions without.

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Matching regions, ordered by cloud and region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider.
- `engines` (List of String) Database engines served, lowercase.
- `private_endpoints` (Boolean) Whether a `relay_private_endpoint_service` can be created here.
- `region` (String) Cloud region.
